headline: Six Injured After Bus Crashes Near Hongik University Station
seoTitle: Bus Collides With 32 Vehicles in Bundang
metaDescription: A bus veered onto a sidewalk near Hongik University Station in Seoul after colliding with other vehicles, resulting in six injuries on Saturday evening.
aiSummaryBullets: A bus hit a sidewalk in Seoul's Hongik University area on Saturday.
The incident occurred after a collision involving another bus and a car.
Six people were transported to local hospitals for medical treatment.
aiContextParagraph: On November 21, 2026, a traffic incident occurred near Hongik University Station in Seoul when a bus veered onto the pavement. According to reports, the vehicle struck a structure following a collision involving a sedan and another bus at approximately 6:57 p.m. in the entertainment district. Six individuals were injured and required hospitalization for their conditions. Authorities have indicated that there were no fatalities or life-threatening injuries reported from the scene. This event follows a separate large-scale traffic accident reported earlier in the month near Bundang, where a bus collision involving 32 vehicles resulted in dozens of injuries. The recent incident near Hongik University station remains under assessment by relevant authorities regarding the cause of the multi-vehicle contact that led the bus to deviate from the roadway.
whyItIsViral: This event gained attention due to the high-traffic location in a major entertainment district and consistent reporting from six independent news outlets.
